description: This file defines the HookRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repositories to facilitate database operations related to 'Hook' entities, including custom queries for retrieving hooks based on events and template IDs.

classes.name: HookRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for accessing Hook entities, with custom query methods for filtering based on events and template ID.

methods.name: findAllHooksListeningToEvent
methods.description: Fetches all active hooks listening to a specific entity and action, based on the related event's entity and action names.

methods.name: findOneByTemplateId
methods.description: Retrieves a single Hook entity associated with the specified template ID.

calls: select hook from Hook hook inner join hook.events event where event.entityName = :entityName and event.actionName = :actionName and hook.isActive = true
select hook from Hook hook where hook.template.id = :templateId
